narration: Why do cells bother with fermentation?
It regenerates NAD+, so glycolysis can keep going.
Muscle cells turn pyruvate into lactate. Yeast turns it into ethanol and CO2. Either way, only the 2 ATP from glycolysis.
So which kind happens in muscle cells? Lactic acid fermentation.
